objective: Close the plant -> sensor feedback loop in hydragrow-simulator with linear configuration-driven tank dynamics (volume, water level, dosing gain) and deterministic seeded noise model for sensors.

acceptance.criterion: Nutrient A flow calculates EC change using config ec_gain_per_ml, capacity, and pump PWM.
Refill and drain move volume and level consistently and clamp at physical bounds.
Sensor noise is deterministic and reproducible for a seeded NoiseConfig.
Simulator crate passes fmt, clippy -D warnings, and test suites with zero errors.
acceptance.verification: cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo fmt --check
